steps.name: update-recovery-guide-jdk21-sandbox
steps.command:
set -eu; git fetch origin main; test $(git rev-parse origin/main) = f7b4ceba2ede0c1b7bb2595526a4eaf47023abff; git reset --hard origin/main; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md')
s=p.read_text()
old='- [ ] Add a release/stability marker or tag once desired by the maintainer.'
new='- [x] Add recovery tags (`stability-baseline-2026-09-06`, `stability-plan-v1`) and archive old Field MVP state as a tag.'
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
marker='- [ ] Preserve a known APK/export from the pre-recovery baseline if useful for A/B comparison.
'
infra='- [x] Establish sandbox-first execution infrastructure so routine analysis/build/test work does not depend on the Mac.
- [x] Standardize installed build runtime/toolchain on JDK 21 while keeping generated bytecode target at JVM 17.
- [x] Build a reusable offline Android SDK/Gradle cache transport and store bootstrap assets in ChatGPT Library.
'
assert marker in s
s=s.replace(marker, marker+infra, 1)
old_session='3. Read `.agent/binding.json` and live `.agent/status/daemon.json` before local execution.
4. Check `NEXT ACTION`.
5. Inspect current `main` HEAD and changes since the last Work Log entry.
6. Do not begin a later phase while an earlier P0 checklist remains open unless the task is specifically diagnostic.
7. Implement the smallest coherent step.
8. Run targeted tests.
9. Run repository quality gate for published code changes.
10. Build APK when runtime code changed.
11. Update this file in the same work cycle: mark completed checkbox(es), update `NEXT ACTION`, add Work Log entry, and record commit/test evidence.'
new_session='3. Read `docs/SANDBOX_EXECUTION_FLOW.md` and restore the compatible Library sandbox/source/cache assets for substantial work.
4. Read `.agent/binding.json` and live `.agent/status/daemon.json` only before Local Agent/Mac execution.
5. Check `NEXT ACTION`.
6. Inspect current `main` HEAD and changes since the last Work Log entry.
7. Do not begin a later phase while an earlier P0 checklist remains open unless the task is specifically diagnostic.
8. Implement the smallest coherent step.
9. Run targeted tests.
10. Run repository quality gate for published code changes.
11. Build APK when runtime code changed.
12. Update this file in the same work cycle: mark completed checkbox(es), update `NEXT ACTION`, add Work Log entry, and record commit/test evidence.'
assert old_session in s
s=s.replace(old_session,new_session,1)
anchor='| 2026-09-06 | Alert runtime needs explicit ownership and cancellation. | Current policy can prevent future alerts but does not provide a reliable owner for stopping an already playing sound/vibration. |
'
rows='| 2026-09-06 | Standardize build runtime/toolchain on JDK 21 while retaining JVM 17 bytecode target during stabilization. | One installed JDK simplifies sandbox/CI/Mac bootstrap without widening Android bytecode compatibility risk during the runtime recovery freeze. |
| 2026-09-06 | Use adaptive sandbox Gradle concurrency: 3 workers focused, 2 workers broad. | The measured 3-worker full gate exceeded sandbox memory headroom; 2-worker `qualityCheck` and `assembleDebug` both passed fully offline. |
'
assert anchor in s
s=s.replace(anchor,anchor+rows,1)
work_anchor='Append newest entries at the top of this section.

'
work='### 2026-09-06 — Sandbox-first/JDK 21 build infrastructure

- Status: infrastructure verified; product Phase 1 remains next.
- Decision: one installed JDK 21 for Gradle/compiler execution; JVM 17 bytecode target retained.
- Sandbox evidence:
  - exact-SHA source snapshot restored,
  - Android SDK 34 + Build Tools 34 + Gradle dependency cache restored from offline pack,
  - `:core:data:testDebugUnitTest` passed with `--offline` on JDK 21 (`BUILD SUCCESSFUL`, 1m 9s on cold-ish restored cache),
  - `qualityCheck` passed fully offline on JDK 21 with the safe 2-worker sandbox profile (`BUILD SUCCESSFUL`, 40s),
  - `:app:assembleDebug` passed fully offline on JDK 21 with the safe 2-worker sandbox profile (`BUILD SUCCESSFUL`, 28s),
  - a 3-worker/2 GiB full gate caused the Gradle daemon to be killed under lint/detekt/test overlap; broad sandbox gates are therefore capped at 2 workers while focused gates may use 3.
- Mac role reduced to ADB/device/Mac-specific evidence by default.
- Next action: Phase 1 — BLE Stable Core.

---

'
assert work_anchor in s
s=s.replace(work_anchor,work_anchor+work,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
git diff --check; grep -q 'Standardize installed build runtime/toolchain on JDK 21' docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md; grep -q 'qualityCheck.*40s' docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md; git add docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md; git commit -m 'Record sandbox JDK 21 recovery infrastructure'; git push origin HEAD:main; echo VERIFIED_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
